newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian PM to visit China, Singapore.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian PM to visit China, Singapore.

text.p: Australian Prime Minister John Howard said on Sunday that he would visit China and Singapore next month to strengthen ties, particularly those with Beijing which have been strained during the past year.
Howard said he would visit Singapore from March 26-28, and China from March 28 to April 2.
The 25th annniversary of Australia's recognition of China's communist government was an appropriate time to look at ways of improving ties, Howard said in a statement.

"I look forward to discussing with the Premier, Li Peng, and other Chinese leaders, ways in which we can help Australia's thriving economic relationship with China flourish even more, and promote our political links and social ties," he said.
Relations with China have been tenuous during the past year.

Beijing's official media has questioned Australia's commitment to the region and closer military links with the United States, saying such links are part of a pincer with U.S.-Japan ties to isolate China.

In contrast, Australia's relations with Singapore are one of its most stable in the Asian region. "The bilateral relationship with Singapore is strong and my visit provides an opportunity to build on that foundation," Howard said.
